_comment: Example roster manifest for the 4359 overdue policy-change worker. Copy to the deploy host, set spreadsheet_id, and pass the path as payload.manifest_path. The roster MUST read the AppSheet 'Employees' tab (the 'Street Smart Employees' tab is missing people — e.g. Andrea Illanes was absent there 2026-09-27). allowed_columns is a privacy guard: the Employees tab also carries SSN, DOB, salary and commission columns — never add them here.
